resolution.question: Will Brightline Software's three co-founders decide whether the January price increase is going ahead, and tell the team, before the all-hands on the 18th?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if, before the hard cutoff at 2026-12-18T10:00:00-08:00, the persistent event history shows that the three co-founders have collectively decided whether the January price increase is going ahead (i.e., they have reached a decision) AND that decision has been communicated to the team (e.g., via an email, a message, or an announcement at the all-hands meeting). Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
